name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - Après le § 39 - Am 71
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 17z. Welcomes the inclusion of the PEACEPLUS programme in the MFF proposal but is concerned at the omission of a specific allowance in addition to an appropriate allocation from Ireland’s Interreg allocation, as was the case in the previous programme; calls for the additional allocation for the PEACEPLUS programme to be fully preserved;
